scope: RSC-only origin and fallback checks, not Chinese semantic accuracy

checks.name: Every published Chinese value has an exact pinned RSC witness
Changing retained Chinese is rejected even with model or human approval
Historical model corpus and new event/composition payloads are rejected
Typed complete original names work and homographs do not get a global winner
Former generated sentences and prefix composition fall back to Japanese
Unverified original controls and placeholders cannot be silently rewritten
Build inputs and hashes are current and exclude historical model payloads
Standalone handoff loads without upstream data and detects artifact tampering
Legacy model semantic gate refuses to report a current pass
